event.distribution_pattern: The recalled peanut products were distributed to two (2) customers: Country Oven Bakery, Bowling Green, KY and Smith's Bakery, Layton, UT.

products.product_description: Medium Chopped Peanut Granules, Product Code #410016, packaged in 30 lb. vacuum packed plastic bags within cardboard shipping boxes. The total packaging size is 2100 lbs = 70 x 30 lb boxes.
products.reason_for_recall: The recalling firm manufactured and distributed peanut products which contained peanuts and/or peanut butter which they received from there bulk peanut supplier, Peanut Corporation of America (PCA). Peanuts and peanut products produced by PCA have been implicated in a recent outbreak of salmonellosis and these product may be contaminated with Salmonella Typhimurium.
